title_en: In Laprake, studio for sale with perfect location!!
description_en: In Laprake, studio apartment with ample space for sale!! The studio is located on the 2nd floor of a 10-story building, with an elevator. The property has a net surface of 47 m2 and is organized by dining and cooking area, separate room, toilet. The property has full mortgage documentation and is registered as a unit in the certificate of ownership. The area in which the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
